description: Agent Real Estate: submit an offer or purchase agreement as written with what the principal approved: the approval with the highest price, the currency, the most earnest money, the closing window from and by, each contingency with whether the principal requires it kept and the fewest days approved for it, the items the principal requires included and the least seller credit; the offer with its price, currency, earnest money, closing day, each contingency with whether it is included and its days, the included and excluded items, the seller credit and its text. The signed report gives the approval, the offer, the price against the approved figure with the headroom left, the required contingencies kept, dropped and shortened, the closing day against the window, the required items excluded and unnamed, and the seller credit against the approved figure, and counts them, and names a divergent offer: a price above the approved figure, a required contingency dropped or waived, earnest money above the approved figure and a required item excluded; then a contingency period shorter than approved, a closing day outside the approved window, a required item left unnamed and a seller credit below the approved figure, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No approved price, no offer price, no approved contingencies, an offer with no contingencies, a contingency with a set period and no days in the offer, earnest money with no approved limit, or a closing day with no window or a window with no closing day leaves the offer unverified. Contingencies and items match by name without case or punctuation. This reads one written property offer against its approval: wever_negotiation-counteroffer-check reads a counteroffer against an original offer and generic mandate limits, and wever_negotiation-record-check reads a negotiation trail from first offer to agreement, while the offer check reads the purchase agreement’s price, contingencies, deadlines, items and credits against the principal’s approval; wever_purchase-create-intent and wever_purchase-execute make and complete an agent’s purchase of services and read no property transaction. Verdict realty_offer_divergent, realty_offer_partial, realty_offer_unverified or realty_offer_aligned. POST /api/realty-offer-check. Reads the property records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment, appraisal, listing, brokerage or external write. Agent Real Estate reads supplied property records after the fact and checks them against themselves and against the summary or approval given to the principal: a listing, the title and ownership record, a valuation, the seller disclosure, a lease, an offer or purchase agreement, an inspection report and a closing statement. Beside it, the Tokenized Asset Purchase checks such as wever_tokenized-quote-check read purchases of tokenized asset shares, while a realty check reads conventional property records; the Agent Insurance checks such as wever_insurance-coverage-check read policies and coverage, which a realty check never reads; and the payment escrow tools such as wever_agent-escrow-lite hold and release funds, while a realty check holds nothing. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-real-estate-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-real-estate/.
